rationale: The only report site, ArchitectureExtensions.MustRespectRegexNamingConvention, reports the declaration, its kind and the pattern for each declaration of the selection whose name does not match; the message states this accurately and gives the expected pattern.
codeChange: MustRespectNamingConvention converts its star pattern to a regular expression before calling MustRespectRegexNamingConvention, so the message shows '^.*Reader$' when the user wrote '*Reader'. Passing the original display pattern, as DerivedTypesMustRespectRegexNamingConventionAttribute does with DisplayPattern for LAMA0903, would make the message match the source code. Also, the XML documentation of MustRespectRegexNamingConvention contains the typo 'fails  not respect'.
